title: Marketplaces and quick commerce
hired_for: An owner hires this screen so every marketplace the brand sells on makes money after all fees, pays what it owes, and never suspends the account, without the owner living in 5 seller portals.

jobs.job: Keep my seller accounts safe from suspension
jobs.why: One suspended account can stop all marketplace sales overnight and freeze the money already owed. The owner wants to see the warning signs weeks before the platform acts.

watch.metric: order defect rate and late shipment rate per marketplace, trailing 60 days, against the platform's own limits (Amazon: under 1% and under 4%)
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Account Health, Walmart Seller Center performance

drives.metric: days of marketplace selling lost to suspension or listing holds

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: Amazon order defect rate is 0.8%, close to the 1% line, and nobody has looked in 5 weeks. After: the 3 root causes are fixed and the rate sits at 0.3% within 30 days.

jobs.job: Make sure each marketplace pays me what my orders say I am owed
jobs.why: Settlement reports mix sales, fees, refunds, holds and reserves, so short payments hide in the noise. Money not claimed inside the platform's window is gone for good.

watch.metric: settlement shortfall: expected payout from order records minus actual payout, per settlement cycle
watch.source: marketplace settlement reports (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop) joined to order records

drives.metric: cash received from marketplaces per month

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the last 2 Amazon cycles paid $3,400 less than orders justify, with no named cause. After: each gap is tagged by cause and $2,900 is recovered through cases within 30 days.

jobs.job: Know what each marketplace really makes after every fee
jobs.why: Revenue on Amazon or Walmart looks large, but referral, fulfilment, storage, ad and return fees can take most of it. The owner needs to know which channels and products earn money before putting more stock and ad money into them.

watch.metric: contribution margin per unit by marketplace and product, after referral, fulfilment, storage, ad and return fees, monthly
watch.source: marketplace settlement and fee reports plus landed cost from the brand brain

drives.metric: total marketplace contribution margin per month

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: Amazon shows $180,000 in monthly sales but nobody knows the margin. After: 6 products are shown to lose $2 to $5 a unit after fees and are repriced or pulled within 30 days.
jobs.who_today: founder with a spreadsheet, or nobody

jobs.job: Keep my best sellers in stock at Amazon warehouses
jobs.why: A stockout on Amazon loses the sales and also the search rank, which can take weeks to win back. Too much stock costs storage fees and ties up cash.

watch.metric: count of top products with under 30 days of stock at Amazon warehouses, updated daily
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Restock and FBA Inventory reports

drives.metric: days out of stock on top products per month

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 4 of the top 20 products have under 30 days of cover and a 45 day restock time. After: shipments are booked and no top product runs out in the next quarter.

jobs.job: Stop marketplace ads that cost more than the sale earns
jobs.why: Sponsored ads are easy to overspend on because the platform reports sales, not profit. Each campaign needs to stay under the ad cost the product's margin can carry.

watch.metric: ad cost as a share of ad sales, per campaign, against each product's break-even share, trailing 14 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads console, Walmart Connect, TikTok Shop ads

drives.metric: total ad cost as a share of all marketplace sales, monthly

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 35% of Amazon ad spend sits in campaigns above break-even. After: those campaigns are cut or rebuilt and total ad cost falls from 14% to 10% of sales within 30 days.

jobs.job: Keep every listing live and free of errors
jobs.why: Listings get suppressed or hidden for a missing field, a bad image or a policy flag, and sales stop without an alert. The owner wants to know the same day, not when revenue drops.

watch.metric: count of listings suppressed, inactive or carrying an open error, per marketplace, daily
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central listing quality dashboard, Walmart Seller Center item errors, TikTok Shop product status

drives.metric: sessions on sellable listings per week

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 9 listings are suppressed on Amazon and 14 have errors on Walmart. After: all are fixed within 5 days and weekly sessions on those items return to their prior level.

jobs.job: Stop paying for ads while someone else wins the Add to Cart button
jobs.why: On Amazon, the seller who holds the main Add to Cart button (the Buy Box) gets the sale. If a reseller holds it, the brand's ad money pays for their sale.

watch.metric: share of time the brand holds the Buy Box on products that are running ads, trailing 7 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Business Reports (featured offer percentage)

drives.metric: ad sales that land on the brand's own offer

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 3 advertised products hold the Buy Box only 62% of the time. After: price and stock gaps are fixed and all 3 are back above 95% within 14 days.

jobs.job: Sell at the same price and stock level on every channel
jobs.why: When marketplace price or stock drifts from the store, the brand oversells, cancels orders and hurts account health, or undercuts its own site.

watch.metric: count of products where marketplace price or available stock differs from the store, daily
watch.source: Shopify products and inventory compared to marketplace seller tools

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 22 products show a different price or stock count on Walmart than on the store. After: one shared product feed fixes all 22 and cancellations fall from 30 to under 5 a month.
jobs.who_today: marketplace manager or an inventory app

jobs.job: Tell whether a sales drop is a traffic problem or a listing problem
jobs.why: When marketplace sales fall, the fix is different if fewer people saw the product or if fewer of them bought. Guessing wrong wastes weeks.

watch.metric: sessions and share of sessions that bought (unit session percentage) per product, last 7 days against the 7 before
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Business Reports

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: sales fell 18% and the team blames ads. After: sessions held steady and the buy rate fell from 14% to 11% after a price change, so the price is reset within a week.

jobs.job: Turn more product page visits into sales on each marketplace
jobs.why: Images, title, bullets and brand content decide whether a shopper buys once they land. A small lift in buy rate on a top product is worth more than new traffic.

watch.metric: share of sessions that bought (unit session percentage) per top product, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Business Reports, Walmart Seller Center item performance

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the hero product converts 9% of sessions against 13% for the next best. After: new images and a comparison chart lift it to 11% within 30 days.

jobs.job: Ship my own marketplace orders on time
jobs.why: Orders the brand ships itself are judged on late shipment, cancellations and valid tracking. Missing these limits costs badges, rank and in the end the account.

watch.metric: late shipment rate and valid tracking rate on self-shipped orders, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Account Health, Walmart Seller Center on-time delivery

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: Walmart on-time delivery is 88%, under the 90% target. After: the warehouse cut-off time moves and on-time delivery is 95% within 3 weeks.

jobs.job: Keep star ratings high enough that shoppers do not skip us
jobs.why: Shoppers filter and scroll past products under about 4 stars. A falling rating slowly cuts buy rate and rank, and the cause is often one fixable product flaw.

watch.metric: average star rating and share of 1 and 2 star reviews per top product, trailing 90 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Customer Reviews, Walmart Seller Center reviews

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the best seller slipped from 4.5 to 4.2 stars and 40% of bad reviews mention sizing. After: the size chart and product fix lift new reviews to 4.5 within 90 days.

jobs.job: Stop counterfeit sellers and hijackers on my listings
jobs.why: Fake products on the brand's own listing bring bad reviews, returns and lost sales, and they damage trust everywhere the brand sells.

watch.metric: count of open hijacker offers and reported counterfeit listings, weekly
watch.source: Amazon Brand Registry, Walmart Brand Portal

drives.metric: share of time the brand holds the Buy Box

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 3 unknown sellers are on the hero listing. After: reports are filed through Brand Registry and all 3 are removed within 14 days.

jobs.job: Get back money the marketplace owes for lost stock and wrong fees
jobs.why: Amazon loses and damages units in its warehouses and sometimes charges the wrong size fee. Reimbursement is not automatic and claims expire.

watch.metric: value of open and recovered claims for lost or damaged units and fee overcharges, monthly
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Inventory Ledger and fee preview reports

drives.metric: cash recovered from marketplaces per quarter

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 140 units show as lost with no claim filed. After: claims are filed for all of them and $2,100 is credited within 45 days.

jobs.job: Show up for the search words that sell
jobs.why: Most marketplace sales start with a search. If the listing does not rank for the words buyers type, ads have to pay for every sale.

watch.metric: organic rank for the top 10 search words per hero product, weekly
watch.source: Amazon Brand Analytics Search Query Performance

drives.metric: organic sessions per product per month

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the hero product ranks on page 1 for 3 of its top 10 words. After: title, bullets and backend terms are rewritten and it ranks on page 1 for 7 within 60 days.

jobs.job: Keep compliance papers current so listings are not pulled
jobs.why: Some products need safety certificates, labels or warnings. A missing or expired document can pull a live listing without warning.

watch.metric: count of live listings with a missing or expired compliance document, weekly
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central Account Health (product policy compliance) and the brand brain document list

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 5 products have no current safety certificate on file. After: all 5 are uploaded and the policy warnings clear within 14 days.

jobs.job: Make deal events pay, not just sell
jobs.why: Prime Day, coupons and lightning deals push volume, but a deep discount plus fees plus ads can lose money on every unit.

watch.metric: contribution margin per unit during each deal event compared to normal weeks
watch.source: marketplace settlement reports and Amazon Ads console

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: last Prime Day sold 3x normal volume at a loss of $1.20 a unit. After: the next event uses a smaller discount on 4 products and makes $2.80 a unit.

jobs.job: Check what rapid-delivery ads really return
jobs.why: Grocery and rapid-delivery apps (Instacart, DoorDash, Gopuff; India: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) often count ad sales at list price. The real return on the price actually paid can be far lower.

watch.metric: ad return calculated on the price actually paid, against the platform's reported return, trailing 30 days
watch.source: rapid-delivery platform ad and order exports

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the platform shows 4.0x ad return. After: the true figure on paid price is 2.6x, so spend is capped until it clears break-even.

jobs.job: Stop resellers pricing my products below my minimum advertised price
jobs.why: When a reseller undercuts the price, shoppers learn to wait for a discount and the brand's own site stops converting.

watch.metric: count of products with a third-party offer below the minimum advertised price, trailing 7 days
watch.source: marketplace seller tools and offer listings

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 7 products are listed 15% to 25% under the set price by 2 resellers. After: both are traced and stopped and prices hold within 30 days.
jobs.who_today: founder, or a brand protection service

jobs.job: Cut storage fees and old stock at marketplace warehouses
jobs.why: Slow stock sitting over 6 months draws extra storage fees and lowers the storage limit Amazon grants.

watch.metric: storage fees as a share of Amazon sales and units aged over 181 days, monthly
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central FBA Inventory and storage fee reports

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: storage fees are 4.5% of Amazon sales and 1,800 units are over 181 days old. After: aged units are sold down or removed and fees fall to 2% within 60 days.

jobs.job: Decide which marketplaces to add, grow or drop
jobs.why: Each marketplace takes stock, staff time and tools. The owner wants to put effort where the contribution margin is, not where the sales number is biggest.

watch.metric: contribution margin per marketplace per month after fixed costs such as tools and staff time
watch.source: marketplace settlement reports plus costs in the brand brain

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 4 marketplaces are live and 1 loses $1,500 a month after staff time. After: that one is paused and the stock moves to the 2 that earn the most, within a quarter.

jobs.job: Stop marketplace returns from eating the profit
jobs.why: Returns on marketplaces often come back unsellable, and the return reasons point to a fixable product or listing problem.

watch.metric: return rate and top return reason per product, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central returns report, Walmart Seller Center returns

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: one product has a 14% return rate and half say it runs small. After: the listing adds a sizing note and returns fall to 8% within 60 days.

jobs.job: Get paid back for the shoppers I send to Amazon
jobs.why: Brands that send their own traffic to Amazon can earn a bonus back and learn which ads drove sales there. Without tracking links that money and insight are lost.

watch.metric: Brand Referral Bonus earned and Amazon sales from tagged outside traffic, monthly
watch.source: Amazon Attribution and Brand Referral Bonus reports

drives.metric: marketplace ad cost as a share of sales

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: Meta and email send traffic to Amazon with no tags and no bonus. After: all links carry tracking tags and earn $900 a month in bonus within 60 days.

jobs.job: Keep hero products in stock in rapid-delivery dark stores
jobs.why: On rapid-delivery apps, a product out of stock in local dark stores drops out of search and loses rank fast. Only applies where the brand sells on these apps.

watch.metric: share of dark stores with the hero products in stock, daily
watch.source: rapid-delivery platform inventory reports

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: the hero product is out in 35% of dark stores for 3 days running. After: the reorder cycle is shortened and it stays in stock in over 90% of them.

jobs.job: Keep smaller marketplace listings fresh
jobs.why: Listings on Walmart, Target Plus, eBay or TikTok Shop often get set up once and forgotten, with old images, prices and copy that lose to newer competitors.

watch.metric: count of listings not updated in 90 days, per marketplace, and sessions per listing
watch.source: Walmart Seller Center, Target Plus, eBay and TikTok Shop seller tools

drives.metric: sales per listing per month on smaller marketplaces

jobs.now_after: Example: Now: 60 of 80 Walmart listings have not changed in over 90 days. After: the top 20 get current images and copy and their sessions rise 25% within 60 days.
